name: mindfora-webapps
description: Mindfora Android app (Capacitor WebView shell for https://mindfora.id)

scripts.sync: npm run build && cross-env MINDFORA_ENV=production cap sync android
scripts.sync:dev: npm run build:dev && cross-env MINDFORA_ENV=development cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:debug:dev: npm run sync:dev && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
